title: Integrable densities on finitely many faces define a current
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1. Let s be a finite set of pairs p = (ι, b) with ι : Fin n → Fin P (arbitrary; no monotonicity is needed) and b : Fin P → ℤ, and let w : (pairs) → ℝⁿ → ℝ be such that w_p is Lebesgue integrable on Q₁ := {y ∈ ℝⁿ : 0 < y_i < 1 ∀ i} for every p ∈ s (ℝⁿ = Euclid n with volume). Write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1, Φ_p(y) := toLp(b) + Σ_j y_j e_{ι(j)} ∈ ℝ^P and E_p := (e_{ι(0)}, …, e_{ι(m)}). Then: (I) for every test n-form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (ω : TestFormOn univ n, a C^∞ compactly supported n-form) and every p ∈ s, the function y ↦ w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(E_p) is integrable on Q₁; (II) there is a current D ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) with D(ω) = Σ_{p∈s} ∫_{Q₁} w_p(y)·ω(Φ_p(y))(E_p) dy for every test n-form ω.
